limitations: Source amplitude, receiver noise, threshold offset and AM depth are explicit hypotheses, not a qualified input circuit.

Input AM at 1 MHz; cyclostationary additive-noise modulation omitted.

Absolute static propagation delay omitted; no latency or input-circuit qualification.

transmitter.scope: Selected native 10-bit DAC and third-order reconstruction at the existing 20 MHz wideband cutoff. Same shared rail/reference/clock realization as RX, external observer with ideal framing and known DATA training. Broad power bands are not a spectral mask. A supplied driver-wake trajectory changes rail/reference/timing and available tail-current limit within the existing 28 mA reservation; otherwise warm constant bias. No signal-dependent RF-cycle current, physical DAC glitches, real FIFO/control lifecycle or external RF filtering. Output impedance/distortion and ENOB remain assigned requirements.
